name: Tantive II
description: Tantive II was a CR90 corvette used by the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. When Biggs Darklighter's X-wing broke down while carrying the recently intercepted schematics for the Death Star, the Tantive II, along with the Tantive I and the Tantive III, was sent to escort Lambda-class T-4a shuttles which would restore the X-wing's power generator.
